tei:div.tei:p: (na)༄༅// ba ri ba'i chos skor gyi brgyud 'debs bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti siddhāṃ/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gis byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas// grangs med gsum du brtson pas rab bsgrubs pas// tshogs gnyis mthar phyin rang gzhan don brnyes pa// ston pa bder gshegs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes bla na med// gcig tu bsdus pa rgyal sras gzhon nu'i tshul// shes rab ral gri utpal 'dzin brtson pa// mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod ni shes bya kun la rab sbyangs nas// ting 'dzin brtson pas go 'phang mchog brnyes te// gzhan gyi don la gcig tu rab gzhol ba// dgra las rnam par rgyal ba'i zhabs la 'dud// bde gshegs bstan pa'i gsung rab rin chen gyis// thugs kyi bang mdzod rab tu gtams byas nas// chos kyi sbyin pas sems can tshim mdzad pa// rdo rje gdan pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba'i rigs 'khrungs byams pa'i thugs dang ldan// tshul khrims gzugs bzang yon tan rgyan gyis spras// brtse bas 'gro la ma nor lam ston pa// rdo rje gdan pa gnyis pa'i zhabs la 'dud// byang sems sa bon snying rje'i chu yis bskyed// yon tan ljon shing rtogs pa'i 'bras bu can// gzhan don bsdu ba'i bsil grib dang ldan pa// rin chen grags pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jam dbyangs ye shes nyi ma'i gsung zer gyis// mkhyen pa padmo'i tshal rab rgyas byas nas// legs bshad bdud rtsi'i dga' ston 'gyed mdzad pa// rje btsun sa skya pa la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro ba 'di kun bu gcig ltar gzigs pas// skyo ba med par gzhan gyi don brtson pa// rgyal sras thu bo 'jig rten kun gyi rje// dpal ldan rtse mo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod thugs srid pa'i 'ching las rnam grol yang*// brtse bas srid par skye ba'i tshul bstan pas// skye rgu kun gyi 'dren pa mchog gyur pa// rnal 'byor dbang phyug rgyal mtshan zhabs la 'dud// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku// gcig tu bsdus pa dpal ldan chos kyi rje// gzhan gyi don du skye bo'i skur ston pa// ye shes dbang phyug zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// kha skong ni/

sgrub pa'i brgyud 'dzin tshogs sgom kun dga' dpal// nyams rtogs mnga' bdag bsod nams brtan pa dang*// mkhas shing grub brnyes bla ma bsod nams skyabs// gzungs kyi dpal ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// mtshungs med chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims zhabs// mkhas btsun chen po ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal// rgyal bas lung bstan ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*// rgyal tshab dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// phrin las rmad byung yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel// smra ba'i seng ge dkon mchog lhun grub zhabs// rdo rje 'dzin pa dkon mchog dpal ldan dang*// kun dga' bkra shis rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// shar chen mkhas grub shes rab 'byung gnas che// rig grol gnyis ldan bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhabs// rnam 'dren dam pa lhun grub dpal ldan dang*// kun dga' bkra shis rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jam dpal gzhon nu bsod nams rin chen zhabs// bstan pa'i nyi ma kun dga' blo gros dpal// mkhas btsun grub brnyes nam mkha' 'chi med dang*// dpal ldan phrin las rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes gcig bsdus nas// gdul bya'i snang ngor bshes gnyen mchog gi tshul// lhag pa'i lha dang dbyer med bka' drin can// rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// mgon po khyod kyis cho 'phrul gsum brnyes pas// gdul bya kun gyi mos pa ji bzhin du// rnam 'phrul du mas yongs su tshim mdzad pa// mdzad pa mtha' yas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// stobs bcu'i stobs dang yang dag rab ldan pas// bdud kyi stobs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad cing*// gdul bya'i byang chub lam kun rdzogs mdzad pa// bsam yas mthu ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod ni gzungs dang ting 'dzin rmad byung dang*// mi 'jigs yang dag rig la dbang 'byor pas// the tshom drwa ba kun nas 'grol mdzad pa// ston mchog khyod la rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo// ma 'dres yon tan drug phrag gsum ldan pas// lhar bcas 'jig rten kun gyi skyabs gyur cing*// 'phags pa'i tshogs kyi bla ma mchog gyur pa// 'dren mchog khyod la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// mtshungs med bla ma'i mchog rab de dag la// rtag tu gus pas bdag ni skyabs su mchi// rkang gi khong nas rab tu gsol ba 'debs// rnam pa kun du bdag la byin gyis rlobs// nye bar bkod dang bdag pos ma bzung dang*// yid kyis sprul dang bla na med pa yi// mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po mtha' yas pas// bla ma'i tshogs dang dkon mchog mchod par bgyi// sdig pa 'gyod cing sdom pa'i sems kyis bshags// dge ba ma lus pa la yi rangs shing*// bla med chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// rtag tu mya ngan mi 'da' gsol ba 'debs// dge ba 'di dang dge ba'i rtsa ba gzhan// ma lus blo yis gcig tu bsdoms byas nas// mkha' mnyam sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par shog

/skye dang skye ba dag ni thams cad du// yon tan bdun ldan lha mi'i lus thob nas// dpal ldan bla ma mchog dang mi 'bral zhing*// rtag tu de nyid mnyes pa'ang byed par shog /de yi gsung las theg mchog zab mo'i don// thon shing khong du tshud par byas nas kyang*// gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i spyod pa ji snyed pa// gegs med pa yang ci bder spyod par shog /skad cig re re la yang phyogs bcu yi// zhing rnams kun tu sangs rgyas thams cad las// dam chos rgya mtsho thos shing de dag gi// ye shes gzigs pa'i dam pa 'jug gyur cig /sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las rgya mtsho dang*// rgyal sras mchog gi mdzad pa rgya mtsho dang*// bdag gi byang chub spyod pa 'dres gyur nas// sems can thams cad smin par byed par shog /de ltar byang chub lam gyi spyod pa kun// thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byas nas kyang*// rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes rgya mtsho dang*// rnam pa kun tu ro gcig 'gyur bar shog /skye ba 'di nyid du yang tshe ring zhing*// nad med pa dang longs spyod phun sum tshogs// bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba dang*// yid la 'dod pa thams cad 'grub gyur cig /tshul 'di ni dpal ldan bla ma chos kyi rje sa skya paṇḍi ta chen po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa'i btsun pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos shing pho stag gi lo bya spo'i tshes bco lnga la mdo khams sgang du sbyar ba'o// de la ba ri ba'i chos skor zhes bya ba ni/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi zhal snga nas/ rje ba ri snying rje chen po dang ldan pas chos bsam gyis mi khyab kyang gtso cher gsungs pa ni/ don yod zhags pa yan lag bcas// rnam rgyal yan lag bcas pa dang*// sgrub thabs bsdus pa dag dang ni// rdo rje gdan pa'i chos drug dang*// dang po'i las pa'i bya

slob dpon bsod nams rtse mos mdzad pa dang*/ rje btsun grags pa'i chos spyod rin chen phreng ba sogs kyang gtso bo gzhung 'di la brten nas mdzad/ bar bcas/ /tshe dpag med /lha dgu la sogs bsam mi khyab// ba ri rin chen grags pa yis// bod la phan pa'i don du bsgyur// zhes pa rnams so// de las 'dir tshogs sgom rin po che nas bzung brgyud pa'i zhal skong rnams sgrub thabs bsdus pa'am/ deng sang sgrub thabs brgya rtsar grags pa'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa dang mthun par sbyar ba ste/ chos skor gzhan rnams kyi rgyun yang bar ma chad par bzhugs pas sbyor bar spro na so so'i brgyud yig ltar kha bskang bar bya'o// zhes pa'ang mañdzū gho ṣas so// sarba dā maṅgalaṃ bhū yātra// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
